eyebrow: Network first -- NSGs scoped tight from rule one
code:
az network vnet create --name harrowpeak-prod-vnet \
  --address-prefix 10.20.0.0/16 \
  --subnet-name app-subnet --subnet-prefix 10.20.1.0/24

az network nsg create --name app-subnet-nsg
az network nsg rule create --nsg-name app-subnet-nsg \
  --name Allow-HTTPS-Inbound --priority 100 \
  --access Allow --protocol Tcp --destination-port-ranges 443

az network nsg rule create --nsg-name mgmt-subnet-nsg \
  --name Allow-RDP-FromOffice-Only --priority 100 \
  --access Allow --source-address-prefixes 203.0.113.44/32 \
  --destination-port-ranges 3389
caption: VNet, then subnets, then NSGs -- each rule scoped to what that subnet actually needs, not opened wide and fixed later.
